title: Account
description: Your profile, sign-in, and agency membership.
profileBlurb: Update how you appear across the app.
displayNameHint: Shown next to your avatar across the app.
avatarUrlHint: Paste a link to a hosted image (https://…). Leave blank to use your initials.
languageHint: Choose the language for the app interface.
passwordChange: Enter your current password to choose a new one.
passwordSet: Set a password to also sign in with email + password.
passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
forgotPasswordLink: Forgot your password? Email me a reset link.
notificationsBlurb: Choose which events appear in the bell and which we email you about. Invitations and security events are always sent.
emailOnMentionHint: Sends a one-off email when someone @mentions you in a comment. Off by default.
dailyDigestHint: A morning summary of assignments, approvals, and unanswered mentions. Off by default.
bellColumnHint: Show this event in the bell popover.
emailColumnHint: Send a one-off email when this event happens. Off by default.
inAppLockedHint: Always on — invitations and security events are mandatory.
noAgencyYet: You're not yet a member of any agency. If this is your first sign-in, the bootstrap flow will assign you as the agency admin on the next page load.
signOutBlurb: End this session on this device. You can sign back in at any time.

errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.unsupportedLocale: That language is not supported yet.
errors.displayNameTooLong: Display name must be 80 characters or fewer.
errors.nameTooLong: Name must be 80 characters or fewer.
errors.avatarInvalid: Avatar URL must be a valid link.
errors.avatarTooLong: Avatar URL must be 2,048 characters or fewer.
errors.profileInvalid: Check the profile values and try again.
errors.passwordWeak: Password must be at least 8 characters and contain a letter and a digit.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.savePreferencesFailed: We could not save your notification preferences. Try again.
errors.localeCookieSyncFailed: Profile saved, but the language will apply after your next sign-in.
